sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 853)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across three vigilantism crime exposés on *The Green Hornet* (council payoff in 1936; extortion racket in 1938; river barge hijacking in 1941), two River's End medical dramas starring Jean Hersholt on *Dr. Christian* for Chesebrough-Pond's Vaseline (1944, 1950), and Alvino Rey and His Orchestra playing live from the Aragon Ballroom on *One Night Stand* (1944).
All titles are strictly canonical and clean, preserving performer and network details in the narrative description:
